phrases.phrase: Could not verify API connection. Please check your API key.
Your Paylix API key. You can find this in your Paylix dashboard under Security settings.
You must provide an API key to set up this profile.
You must provide a webhook secret to set up this profile.
Your Paylix webhook secret. This is used to verify webhook signatures from Paylix. You can find this in your Paylix dashboard under Webhook settings.
